text:
anna: Quick heads-up — release tomorrow 09:00 PT. Need docs site staging deploy + SDK docs regen done before code cutoff at 23:00 PT tonight. Can folks confirm ownership?

mike: I can handle staging deploy but need the final changelog bump and release branch name.

anna: Branch is release/1.12.0. Changelog bump PR is open: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/672 (needs one more review). If someone can merge by 19:00 PT that gives me time to run docs build.

sanjay: I'll take SDK docs regen (js + py) — do you want them pushed to the docs-staging branch or a separate PR?

anna: Push to docs-staging if possible. After regen, run `make docs-build && ./scripts/publish-staging.sh` — that'll trigger the staging deploy.

sanjay: Got it. Quick Q about credentials — do I use the CI token or my local KMS creds? I can run locally if we prefer not to expose tokens.

anna: Use CI token via GH Actions. We have an action `docs/regen` that already sets up creds. If you run locally for a smoke test, use `export DOCS_ENV=local` and `./scripts/regen-local.sh`.

jess: I'll review the changelog PR now. Ping me if anything needs rewording.

release-bot: [automation] docs-staging job queued (#docs/regen).

mike: Once changelog is merged, I can schedule the staging deploy for 20:30 PT. Can we keep a 30m freeze window after deploy for smoke checks?

anna: Yes — plan: merge by 19:00, regen + publish by 20:30, 20:30-21:00 smoke. If all green, clear for cutoff at 23:00. If not, we'll roll back and open a rollback PR.

sanjay: Starting regen now. Will post logs here when done.

sanjay: regen done — pushed to docs-staging, build passed. logs: https://ci.redwood/run/8492 :tada:

jess: Merged changelog and left one minor wording suggestion, resolved. :thumbsup:

mike: Scheduling staging deploy 20:30. If anyone needs to veto, speak now.

anna: Thanks all — I'll be on standby for the smoke checks after deploy. :coffee:
